admission.justification: Realized across standalone_pr_landing.py::abandoned_contract_reason, record_landing.py::record_landing_result, and tool_answer_l111_test_support.py::RECORD_LANDING_REFUSAL_CODES, proved by test_record_landing_refuses_abandoned_contract_and_preserves_missing_doc, and prevents an abandoned contract from overwriting cleanup: abandoned with pending.

applicability: Every worktree_record_landing dry-run and apply call on any series or leaf contract.
conditions: Evaluated immediately after is_disabled_contract and before the integration_status in {'completed', 'checkpointed'} already-recorded short-circuit.
Refuses with code contract-abandoned when contract.cleanup == 'abandoned' or the contract's own task document reads abandoned, without writing cleanup: pending.
exclusions: A missing or unreadable task document is not treated as abandoned here and falls through to existing checks.
Disabled contracts, which still refuse first through opt_out_refusal_result.
statement: worktree_record_landing refuses contracts whose cleanup or own task document reads abandoned with refusal code contract-abandoned before the already-recorded short-circuit, without treating a missing task document as abandoned and without overwriting cleanup: abandoned, and tool_answer_l111_test_support registers the code.
title: worktree_record_landing refuses abandoned contracts with contract-abandoned
